name: Cache utility
description: Adds the wp-php-toolkit Cache utility via Composer (source: package). Writes no files; only declares the dependency and wiring.

inputs.description: PHP source base directory (for the wiring target file).
Cache key prefix used by the wrapper.

wiring.description: Instantiate the Cache utility once at plugin init. If the project does not use a // scaffold:utilities anchor, place the instantiation near other utility wirings in the bootstrap method.
